name: ironpulse-gym-cloudflare
description: IronPulse Gym fitness membership platform for Cloudflare Pages, Functions and the existing gym D1 database.

scripts.secret:razorpay:key: wrangler pages secret put RAZORPAY_KEY_ID --project-name ironpulse-gym
scripts.secret:razorpay:secret: wrangler pages secret put RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET --project-name ironpulse-gym
scripts.secret:razorpay:webhook: wrangler pages secret put RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET --project-name ironpulse-gym
scripts.secret:stripe:secret: wrangler pages secret put STRIPE_SECRET_KEY --project-name ironpulse-gym
scripts.secret:stripe:webhook: wrangler pages secret put STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET --project-name ironpulse-gym
scripts.secret:whatsapp: wrangler pages secret put WHATSAPP_CLOUD_TOKEN --project-name ironpulse-gym
scripts.secret:greenapi: wrangler pages secret put GREEN_API_TOKEN --project-name ironpulse-gym
scripts.secret:automation: wrangler pages secret put AUTOMATION_API_KEY --project-name ironpulse-gym
scripts.build: npm run check:deployment && npm run build:assets && npm run check:complete && wrangler pages functions build --outdir .build
